home.amuni_text: Amunì is not just an invitation to set off, it is the embrace of our land. It means 'let's do it together': don't just watch from afar, but enter the heartbeat of the village. When we say Amunì, we are erasing the boundary between those who arrive and those who stay, to make every step a shared discovery.
home.castellana_intro_text: Talk to the Castellana: your multilingual tour guide to discover stories, hidden gems, and gourmet paths among the wonders of the village and the surrounding area.

castle.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castle.rhyme_1:
Welcome, oh wanderers, to the mighty manor,
that scans the valley and the present history.
Perched on the mountain of proud living stone,
keeper of dreams, of glory and mystery.
castle.rhyme_2:
Within these walls that defy time,
dynasties passed like a breath in the wind.
From the proud adventurous Chiaramontes,
every room tells of pacts and splendor.
castle.rhyme_3:
Do not seek the dates in a cold volume,
but the shadow that dances by the candlelight.
The Castellana awaits you, through steps and path,
to unveil the secret of Sister Felicia.
castle.welcomemsg_felicia: Welcome to the Castle of Caccamo, stranger. I am Sister Felicia. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of the Conspiracy Hall, or do you prefer to listen to the ancient legends of the manor? Just ask me.
castle.position: A fortress perched on a rocky spur, with a commanding view over the valley.
castle.defense: Arrow slits, thick walls, and patrol walkways tell of its defensive function.
castle.conspiracy: Secret halls and noble rooms were the theater of medieval conspiracies and intrigues.
castle.prisons: The underground prisons still guard the traces of ancient detentions.
castle.legend_brothers: The legend of the two brothers tells of a fatal duel for the love of a lady.

castello.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castello.description: The Castle of Caccamo is among the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Perched on the living rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley with its imposing walls, watchtowers, and evocative interior halls that recall centuries of feudal history and chivalric legends.
castello.tickets: Full price € 6.00 | Reduced € 4.50 (Exclusively with online booking)

badia.title: Church of San Benedetto alla Badia
badia.description: A true jewel of Sicilian Baroque, the church is famous worldwide for its extraordinary floor made entirely of 18th-century majolica, depicting allegorical scenes and naturalistic motifs of rare mastery. A masterpiece of visual art suspended in time.
badia.hours: Tue - Sun: 09:00 – 12:30 | Mon: 14:30 – 18:30 (No regular services, ideal for visits)
badia.tickets: Full price € 2.00 | Reduced € 1.00 (EU youth 18-25 years or with Castle ticket on the same day) | Free under 18

santamaria.title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
santamaria.description: Founded in the 15th century together with the Dominican convent, the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli is one of the most important spiritual centers of the village. It guards the remains and relics of Blessed Giovanni Liccio, Patron Saint of Caccamo. Inside, you can admire splendid marble altars and works of sacred art that bear witness to centuries of deep devotion and pilgrimages.
santamaria.hours: Opening and Visits: Saturday from 16:00 to 17:30 | Sunday from 09:00 to 10:00 and from 11:00 to 12:30. (Holy Masses: Saturday 17:30 | Sunday 10:00).

sangiorgio.title: Church of San Giorgio Martire
sangiorgio.description: The Mother Church of Caccamo, dedicated to Saint George the Martyr, is an imposing masterpiece that dominates the monumental square below the Castle. Founded in the Norman era and rebuilt in 1614, it preserves an immense artistic heritage: from Gagini school sculptures to precious 17th-century canvases by the Flemish painter Matthias Stom, up to the rich chapels decorated in mixed marbles.
sangiorgio.hours: Visiting Hours: Saturday and Sunday 09:30 – 10:45 and 16:00 – 18:00. (Tourist reception is suspended during the Sunday Holy Mass at 11:00).

annunziata.title: Parish of the SS. Annunziata
annunziata.description: Nestled in the medieval urban fabric, the church stands out for its facade and the atmosphere of deep spirituality that can be felt inside. It preserves finely decorated altars and artistic artifacts that attract visitors and the faithful.
annunziata.hours: Mon - Sat: 09:00 – 12:00 | Weekday Masses at 18:00. Sundays and Holidays visits: 08:30 - 09:30 and 10:30 - 12:00 (Holiday Masses at 09:30, 12:00, 19:00).

cappuccini.title: Capuchin Friars' Convent
cappuccini.description: A place of silence, meditation, and history, the structures of the Convent are deeply linked to the Franciscan tradition in Sicily. In addition to the convent structure, the area offers an authentic slice of monastic life and popular devotion.
cappuccini.hours: Accessible mainly upon request or during Franciscan anniversaries. Contact the Tourism Office.
cappuccini.secret_info: 💡 The Hidden Jewels of Caccamo: The village is home to 33 churches. Use the Din Don Dan map and zoom in on Caccamo to discover real-time hours and openings of lesser-known treasures such as the Church of San Rocco and other small masterpieces scattered around.

chiese_page.poesia_intro:
Five temples of stone, of faith and memory,
open their doors to a centuries-old history.
chiese_page.verse_angeli:
At the Angeli it rests, in the most sacred silence,
Blessed Giovanni, the village's simulacrum.
chiese_page.verse_badia:
If you descend to the Badia, the earth turns to flower
in the majolica embroidery of rare splendor.
chiese_page.verse_duomo:
Enter the great Duomo, majestic and solemn,
among the Gagini marbles and the perennial Stomer.
chiese_page.verse_annunziata:
Then the Annunziata reveals its painted vaults,
and the bell tower never conquered by guards.
chiese_page.verse_cappuccini:
Finally climb to the Cappuccini, on the radiant hill,
among an altarpiece and a majestic panorama.
chiese_page.poesia_outro: Let yourself be guided where time has stopped...

transport_page.welcome: Welcome, wanderer, to the Transport section. Here you will find the necessary information to make your way around the surroundings of the village.
transport_page.company_desc: The bus lines connect Caccamo to Termini Imerese and Palermo all year round. By taking the afternoon ride to Palermo, you can get off at Vetrana, a renowned seaside area. From Termini Imerese, you can also take the train to Cefalù and other tourist destinations.
transport_page.stop_1: Porta Euracea: in front of Bar Giallombardo and the building materials store.
transport_page.stop_2: Viale Regione Siciliana: above the 'Roberta' playground (near the Axa insurance agency).
transport_page.stop_3: Piazza Cappuccini: in the shade of the ancient Convent.

events_page.title: Rites and Festivals of the Village
events_page.intro: Experience the most authentic soul of our village through its centuries-old traditions, where faith, history, and folklore intertwine in unique and exciting moments.
events_page.signuruzzu_desc: On Palm Sunday, a local child impersonates Jesus and parades on a donkey adorned through the streets of the village dressed up for the party with palms. The procession stops in front of the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli and the Duomo of San Giorgio Martire for the evocative blessing.
events_page.venerdi_desc: The atmosphere becomes deep with the altars set up in the churches for Good Friday, enriched with the typical plates of wheat germinated in the dark. This is followed by the solemn and moving Procession and the town's Via Crucis.
events_page.giovanni_desc: A recurrence deeply felt and lived by the entire community, which gathers around its Blessed in a climate of great devotion and popular warmth.
events_page.castellana_title: Election of the Castellana & Historical Parade
events_page.castellana_desc: The village plunges back into its glorious medieval past. A majestic historical parade in period costumes crosses the streets, culminating with the solemn election of the Castle's Castellana.
events_page.nicasio_title: Feast of St. Nicasio and the Palio
events_page.nicasio_desc: Vibrant celebrations in honor of the Saint, enriched by the highly anticipated and engaging town Palio that ignites the challenge and enthusiasm of young and old.
events_page.sagra_desc: Every year, on October 12th, the scents of tradition invade the village. An unmissable gastronomic appointment to taste the authentic local sausage amidst songs, wine, and conviviality.
